steps.name: Step 1 — Navigate to the fresh pipeline; verify configuration panel + canvas load
Step 2 — Confirm the TOOLS section has no MCP/Toolkit attached yet
Step 3 — Click "Add node" and select "MCP"; config fields render inline
Step 4 — Click the MCP node's Toolkit dropdown; verify it opens
Step 5 — Inspect the open listbox; it has zero real (select-option-*) rows
Step 6 — Close the dropdown without selecting anything
Step 7 — Go back to TOOLS section, click "+ MCP"; search popper opens
